notes.title: First Big Self-Delusion Update
notes.content:
Greetings!
Update 36.26.09 is already available for everyone.

[b]In the September update 36.26.09 you will find:[/b]
[i]UPD - Discount has been removed due to technical issues. I offer my deepest apologies. I hope soon I will be able to solve it and return the discount to Halloween.[/i]

- Fast levels replay.
- Fixes incomprehensible moments of the gameplay.
- Improved indication of events in the game (the appearance of Leshy, Antsybal, Scarecrow).
- Level balance improvements.
- Changed the logic of Antsybal's attack.
- The design of Antsybal has been changed.
- Faster loading of some levels.
- Fixed Leshy's "disappearance" logic from the stage.
- Adding a section with add-ons in which free content will appear later.
- The menu items in the scene selection have been renamed to be more understandable.
- Improved the atmosphere of some levels of the game.
- And much more!

[i]This update mainly aims to improve gameplay and create a better experience for all types of players. The next updates will focus on additional content and new challenges :)[/i]

notes.title: Development preview #1
notes.content:
Hello fans of hardcore horror games!
I've got some news for you about Self-Delusion!

[b]In the next September update:[/b]
- Speed up scene loading.
- Quick replay in case of stepping on Lapot or death from Kolobok. And of course, in any other similar case of death in the game. 
- Improved gameplay and mob abilities.
- Difficulty balance improvements.
- Improved the atmosphere in the some final scenes of the game.
- And much more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40265099/f806286e268a1f6bf2083c7c0a91ecb7123810b4.png[/img]

[b]Further - more interesting![/b]

[h2]Seasonal events[/h2]
1. Ahead of 2 in-game events that add the spirit of the holiday and new achievements and game content. Can you complete the game with the new conditions?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40265099/543801af457d8c9a52339dabd1c09aec00dd45da.png[/img]

[h2]Additional Content[/h2]
2. An additional story scene that continues the game. Many players will be interested in what trials the heroine faced after she ended up in the [SPOILER]. The gameplay will change and a new enemy will appear, which will cause Lena a lot of trouble. You will have to survive in a new location, which has not yet been in the game. Because Since this content will be a continuation of the story, in order to open it, you will need to beat the game at least once on any difficulty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40265099/95e8cc459a003e05fb84d506ccba023c3457c1e0.gif[/img]

[h2]Collectibles[/h2]
3. Collectibles will appear in the game. Finding them will be very difficult.

[h2]Different difficulty[/h2]
4. The game will have new difficulty levels to satisfy the desires of players of any degree of hardcore. In addition, a new Lapot will appear, which will lurk on the ceiling. You knew from the very beginning that there were two of them, right?

[h2]Secret event[/h2]
5. A secret event dedicated to one well-known series, complementing the plot and setting the stage for the release of Self-Delusion 2.

[h2]Details - very soon![/h2]
For your questions and suggestions - [b]selfdelusiongame@gmail.com[/b]


I would like to please you with news about the co-op, but I can’t yet. I want the game experience to be as enjoyable as possible. But while the cooperative game is something completely different from it. For this reason, I did not initially announce the co-op in Steam, because. I'm not sure that it will be so interesting. I'll keep developing and keep you posted!

notes.title: The Self-Delusion is out now on Steam!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=C0nFEMMr14U;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Get ready to survive against bloodthirsty monsters from dark fairy tales![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40265099/a7a5e9182627f36d1fc561104305cce430c197cd.gif[/img]

[b]Self-Delusion [/b]is a survival horror game set amongst creepy fairy tales. 

Upon receiving a concerning letter from her mother, Lena (our main character) decides it is time to return to the place she grew up. Located in the middle of a foreboding forest, Lena is confronted by a mystery when she enters her childhood home. 

Can you help Lena figure out what happened in her old house? 

You will need to fend off the fairytale creatures hunting you: the ones who, up 'til now, have only existed in your imagination.

Key game features: 
- Monsters unique to the horror genre, only found in fairytales and folklore up 'til now.
- Challenging gameplay filled with new and interesting game mechanics. 
- An enthralling storyline that will leave you gasping in shock and on the edge of your seat. 
- Tense atmosphere complete with jump scares and heart hammering races to beat the clock. 
- Alternate endings that shed new insight on the story and add hours of re-playability. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40265099/95e8cc459a003e05fb84d506ccba023c3457c1e0.gif[/img]

On broadcasting today - Hayden Green
[url=https://www.youtube.com/c/HaydenGreen]HaydenGreen youtube[/url]

Developer: Rolling Bread
